CVE-2026-111819.title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2026-3442: Important priority package update for qemu
CVE-2026-111819.description: A use-after-free flaw was found in the OHCI USB host controller emulation (hw/usb/hcd-ohci.c) in QEMU. When an isochronous transfer descriptor is directed at a non-isochronous endpoint, ohci_service_iso_td() can free a heap-allocated USBPacket while a pending asynchronous transfer still holds a reference to it; that reference is later dereferenced when the transfer completes. A malicious guest able to program the emulated OHCI controller can use this to crash the QEMU process on the host (denial of service) and potentially execute arbitrary code in the context of the QEMU process. The issue is fixed in QEMU 11.1.3 and 10.0.15.

CVE-2026-18054.title: Amazon Linux 2 2017.12 - ALAS2-2026-4009: medium priority package update for qemu
CVE-2026-18054.description: A flaw was found in QEMU. The VAPIC setup hypercall in hw/i386/vapic.c does not validate that the writable RAM alias remains within the option ROM window. A privileged guest user on a Q35/KVM machine can position this alias over locked SMRAM, bypassing chipset D_LCK protection and injecting code into System Management Mode memory.

CVE-2026-61402.title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2026-3241: Important priority package update for qemu
CVE-2026-61402.description: A use-after-free vulnerability was found in QEMU's 9pfs subsystem. A race condition between the main thread and a worker thread when processing concurrent Tlcreate and Twalk requests allows a malicious guest user to craft a fid path containing stale heap data, bypassing directory traversal restrictions and escaping the shared directory boundary. This can lead to arbitrary host file read/write and code execution (VM escape) as the QEMU process user.
